title: Polynomial-Time Computability of a Bounded Iteration
statement: Let $f$ be a polynomial-time computable function on bit strings. Suppose there are natural numbers $B,b$ such that, for all bit strings $c,d$ and all natural numbers $j\leq |c|$, the $j$-fold iterate of $f$ applied to $d$ has length at most $B\bigl(|\langle c,d\rangle|+1\bigr)^b$, where $\langle c,d\rangle$ is the self-delimiting pair encoding. Define a state update that leaves a state unchanged when its first decoded component is empty, and otherwise removes the first bit of that component and replaces the second component by its image under $f$. Iterating this update $|S|+1$ times from $S$ gives a polynomial-time computable function of $S$.
